name: Breathing Exercise
summary: Four paced patterns with adjustable breaths, cycle targets, and a session log you can export.
description: Four paced breathing patterns: Box Breathing, 4-7-8, Coherent 5-5, and the Physiological Sigh. Pick one and the big clock steps through each phase with the countdown and a progress ring; pause, resume, and reset on the page. Tune the inhale, hold, and exhale counts and the session target, and each finished session lands in a log with a chart, CSV, and JSON export. The record is the breath; nothing leaves the browser.

records.purpose: Store the selected pattern, cycle count, and finished sessions in the log
